text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Yep, looks like I've got everything! Thank you both!

text_block_list.name: Curren & Fine
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We just wrapped up a photo shoot for a fashion magazine. Apparently, they're doing a feature on Beauty Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan and Fine Motion both have bespoke racewear from her, so they got picked as the models.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I was positively impressed by how quickly you can adapt your pose and expression!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ♪ Back at you! I could totally tell that you've got a lot of experience with photoshoots.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Could I ask you two for your opinion on something? We've got a couple of options for the outdoor shoot location, so could you tell me which one you'd prefer?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow, they all look gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, look! I think this flower park would be lovely. Aren't the flowers just beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Yeah, you're absolutely right, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Sounds great! The flowers make for a colorful backdrop, so we can look forward to some nice, vibrant photos.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, Curren? Have you thought of how you'd like to be photographed at the outdoor shoot?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I've been brainstorming poses based on the concept.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I just knew you'd already have ideas! You're definitely the type to consider how the background frames you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You were really paying attention to your posing during the indoor shoot too. Did you have some sort of theme in your head?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Kind of. My goal was to make the black shades stand out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: When I first saw the outfit Beauty designed for me, I could tell that she chose all black to really bring out my cuteness. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that to say you consider black a cutesy color?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup! What about you, big bro? What vibe does black give you?
choice_data_list: Black is striking—it can't be colored over by someone else.
Black is flexible—it makes other colors stand out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup! What about you, big sis? What vibe does black give you?
choice_data_list: Black is striking—it can't be colored over by someone else.
Black is flexible—it makes other colors stand out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It can't be colored over… Yes, that does sound fitting for you, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Now you'll just have to wait and see the concept in action!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive at the flower park, and shortly after, the shoot starts with some solo shots of Curren.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: That expression is perfect! Those eyes really hit straight in the heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren gives another pose, her motions and smile calm—more mature than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And somehow… she makes the cutesy rural fields blur into splashes of serene, lustrous colors behind her.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Aaand relax! Great job, Curren. You looked really cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's like I'm shaken out of a daze when the photographer lowers his camera and Curren drops the pose.
choice_data_list: You looked so striking and unswayable, posing in that black dress!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Black just totally gives power and confidence, doesn't it? That's what makes it so crazy cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Like sure, you can't color over it, but I think its true strength comes from how black dresses up the colors around it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Take the pink ribbon at my waist. If this were a white dress, the pink would probably look sweet and sugary, but the contrast with black makes it look super classy instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing her explanation, now it makes sense why the flowers behind her look so vivid.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Black stays true to its own style. And that's what cuteness means to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A shade that changes the tone of everything around her… Just like Curren's deep, unshakeable dedication to cuteness.
choice_data_list: Black really looks perfect on you.
Black really looks perfect on you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you mean black looks adorable on me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren's detailed attention to the cute concept is clear in the quality of her photos. They end up being a resounding hit when the magazine hits the shelves!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see… It certainly does play nicely with other colors. Just like how Curren's got a knack for bringing out the best in everyone around her!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Now you'll just have to wait and see the concept in action!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive at the flower park, and shortly after, the shoot starts with some shots of Curren and Fine together.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: You both look great! The flowers really go well with your dresses!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The pair pose together. Maybe it's her dress, but Fine Motion looks just like a fairy admiring all the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And Curren… her expression changes with each pose. One second, she's Fine's sweet fairy friend—the next, she's serious and elegant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The black outfit really stands out against all the floral colors. Curren frames Fine's light green perfectly, accentuating it without drawing attention away from herself.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: All right, that was great! This shot would be amazing as a two-page spread!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, looks like they got a good photo of us! This is all thanks to your clever planning, Curren.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The black of your outfit complemented all the pastel tones beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup, contrast makes colors look more vivid, and it helps outline the foreground, so your green gown won't blend into the field.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, my, you've really thought of everything! Who knew a bit of black fabric could make such a drastic difference.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You can never go wrong with it. I swear, it totally goes with everything!
choice_data_list: So it's flexible—just like how you express your cuteness.
So it's flexible—just like how you express your cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Exactly! ♪ But I'd say that today, it was Fine's cuteness that really helped me shine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You've got your own unique style, and it's suuuper cute. It got me thinking about what I could do to show cuteness in my own uniquely "Curren" way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And that's what led me to the idea of using Beauty's black dress to highlight us and the background. The racewear really came through for me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it absolutely did! It suits your style so well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, when the magazine hits the shelves, it does so with an extra two-page spread of Curren and Fine—and it's a huge hit with fans!
